Definition
[Thick-thin decomposition] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0209 1. ch31:31.39\group Margulis lemma

The $\varepsilon $-thin part consists of points supporting a nontrivial loop of length less than $\varepsilon $; the thick part consists of points where all such loops have length at least $\varepsilon $.
